individual_bounds.D2: three-bit exact-key/default store with at most three exceptions
individual_bounds.D3: one constant probability with denominator dividing two
individual_bounds.D4: three-input NOT/AND/OR straight-line program with at most two instructions
individual_bounds.D5: unknown goal among eight leaves, at most seven equality queries
individual_bounds.D6: unary deterministic controller with at most two states
individual_bounds.D7: one synchronous round at root of a three-node path
individual_bounds.D8: two-bit program genotype with at most one single-bit rewrite

shared_census.domain: all 256 Boolean functions on three bits
shared_census.pair_composition: one AND, OR, or XOR combining one output from each distinct bounded family
shared_census.higher_order: nested two-combiner composition of D5, D6, and D7 outputs
